alt.en: Token and position rows add to X [B, T, C]. The first path normalizes X, projects Q/K/V, splits H heads of width d, scores and masks [B, H, T, T], mixes, joins and projects back to [B, T, C], then adds X. The second path normalizes the sum, expands C to F, applies ReLU, returns to C and adds that sum.
alt.zh-hans: token 与位置相加得到 X [B, T, C]。第一条路径依次归一化、投影 Q/K/V、拆成 H 个宽度为 d 的头，计算并屏蔽 [B, H, T, T] 分数，混合、拼接并投影回 [B, T, C]，再加 X。第二条路径归一化前一次和，将 C 扩为 F，经 ReLU 再返回 C，最后加上前一次和。

拼接 → W_O → U [B, T, C]

flow.en: X goes directly to ADD as well as through the normalized attention branch.
flow.zh-hans: X 一路经过归一化和注意力，另一路直接参与相加。

N₂W₁+b₁ → ReLU [B, T, F] → W₂,b₂ [B, T, C]
